correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the actual 2n-by-2n powered distance matrix from graph distances 1,2,3 and decomposed its zero-sum space into (w,w), (w,-w), and side-difference modes. Eigenvalues are 3^p-2^p-1 (n-1 times), 1-2^p-3^p (n-1), and (n-1)(2^p-1)-3^p (once). Concavity/convexity and monotonicity of 3^p/(2^p-1) give the exact threshold 1 for n=3,4 and unique interior root for n>=5, with no missed later regime. Gram rank -HD_pH/2 yields endpoint affine dimensions 3 (n=3,4) and 2n-2 otherwise and nullities 2,4,1; analytic implicit expansion gives gain log(3)/[log(2)^2(n-1)^2]. Independent BFS distance/eigenvalue checks passed 60 sampled comparisons. Finite checks are not proof of the infinite-n claims.
